answer: Rank influence by an account's position in the cooperation graph, not by how many accounts exist. Value flows along real work ties the way water moves from an inlet to open sea: a clique of clones only recirculates among itself, so its boundary cut to the wider economy stays thin and its combined power stays small. Every verified deal with a stranger is a signal the graph records; a falcon hunting over open ground earns range a lagoon-bound flock never can. Cap each identity's weight at its measured cut, and a sybil farm prices itself worthless.
